text:
Hi there, and thank you for contacting Leafy! 🌿 I know it's a little nerve-wracking waiting to see your new plants on the move, so let me help.

**How long tracking takes to update**
- Tracking is emailed to you when your order ships, and it can take **up to 24 hours** to start showing updates. So if your link is empty right now, that's often completely normal.

**What to do if it still doesn't move**
- If tracking hasn't moved for **4 business days**, or it says delivered but nothing has arrived, please contact us.
- We'll then open a courier investigation, which takes **up to 5 business days**.
- If the parcel turns out to be lost, you can choose either a **free replacement** or a **full refund**.

**One more thing to check**
- Live plants only ship **Monday to Wednesday**. If you ordered a plant after 12 noon on Wednesday, it will ship the following Monday, so tracking won't appear until then.
- In extreme weather (forecast below 35°F or above 95°F), live plants may be held for up to 7 days, and we'd have emailed you about it.

If you share your order number (it looks like LF-123456), I can help figure out which of these applies. Please don't send any card details or passwords.

Thanks for your patience, and please reach out anytime. Happy plant parenting! 🌱
